name: Law of Common Region
axiom: A boundary drawn around things makes them one group, even when they are far apart.
trigger: A dashboard has no borders, so metrics read as one undifferentiated field.

checklist.text: Put related fields inside one card surface with a single border or fill.
Keep at least 16px of padding inside a region so its contents read as contained.
Do not wrap every row in its own border; use a boundary only where grouping matters.
Test whether removing the boundary changes the grouping users report; if not, remove it.

antiPattern.violation: Thirty metrics sit on a bare canvas with only whitespace between them, so no one can tell which belong together.
antiPattern.remediation: Metrics sit in bordered cards with a faint background, each card holding one functional domain.

academicOrigin.title: Common region: A new principle of perceptual grouping
